verdict.rationale: Figma's pricing page fragments show plan-gated features (e.g., 'Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server', 'Unlimited files and projects for a single team', 'Centralized admin tools', 'Publish resources across teams') and AI-specific monetization via purchasable credits (figma-docs-24, figma-docs-29), indicating some tier/feature-gating disclosure exists. However, the evidence never surfaces explicit seat-type definitions, named tiers (e.g., Starter/Professional/Organization/Enterprise) or a clear AI-feature-to-tier mapping, and a community comment even flags confusion over Dev Mode being split into a separate paid license, suggesting gating isn't fully transparent. Missing for 10: explicit seat-type breakdown, named plan tiers with feature comparison, and clear documentation of which AI features are included vs. credit-based per tier.
